exposure: Group A: Received oral caffeine 300mg and placebo block
Group B: Received sphenopalatine ganglion block and placebo tablet
cohort: The study included 30 patients aged 20-50 years old, classified as ASA PS-1 and 2, scheduled for lower segment Cesarean section under spinal anesthesia who developed PDPH.
finding: Sphenopalatine ganglion block was superior to oral caffeine in reducing pain scores and mean duration of treatment for PDPH.
